title: Complete FULL-T6 canonical 46D binding from executable 18377 schema

acceptance.text: d890 is explicitly revoked as predictive-schema authority and 18377 is active; historical files remain preserved.
The exact 4,539 legacy_recovered FULL-T6 targets and all required source evidence are resolved without changing membership or ordering.
Exactly 4,539 legacy rows are computed by the existing executable 18377 production path with zero placeholders and zero unresolved targets.
The final binding has 33,287 targets, preserves all existing CVAT values, and passes target/frame/mask/schema parity.
Final artifact and authority are hash-bound, reproducible, and explicitly marked local-only with no training or GPU.

risks: Legacy source evidence may be incomplete; fail closed per target.
Existing CVAT values must remain byte/numerically unchanged.
A stale declarative d890 reference must not become predictive semantics.
non_actions: Do not train or evaluate a model.
Do not start Studio or use GPU.
Do not recompute the 28,748 CVAT rows unless parity fails.
Do not regenerate FULL-T6 membership or T6 frame ordering.
Do not zero-fill, invent source evidence, rewrite history, or use d890 formulas.

skills.purpose: Keep the schema correction and legacy completion isolated from model or experiment changes.
Verify exact FULL-T6 membership, source counts, frame order, masks, and no silent row changes.
Bind producer, source artifacts, hashes, merge evidence, and final authority without overwrite.
Preserve native-unit and source-boundary semantics even though no metrics or training are run.
Keep each materialization and verification action bounded, observable, and fail-closed.

steps.summary: Publish the narrow d890 revocation and bind active authority to executable schema 18377.
Resolve the exact missing legacy target set and validate all required source evidence without changing population.
Run the existing executable 18377 producer only for the 4,539 missing legacy targets and validate row-level outputs.
Merge the unchanged CVAT rows with computed legacy rows, run complete parity audits, and publish the final authority.
Close with lineage, memory, and protected-path review after the verified local milestone.
